name: BrewUI
one_liner: A point-and-click app for installing and managing Mac software through Homebrew, for people who don't want to use the Terminal.
buyer: Nobody is really buying this. It's a free official convenience utility for developers who already use Homebrew and occasionally want a GUI.
business_use_cases: A Mac-focused IT-support freelancer could show a non-technical client how to use it instead of the Terminal when installing apps, but that's a footnote in a support engagement, not a product.
An enthusiast Mac-setup guide or blog could mention it as one step in a 'new Mac setup' tutorial, with no direct monetization of the tool itself.

money_ideas.idea: No credible standalone business — it's an official free GUI for an already-free package manager, with no natural paying audience

steal_this: Not a weekend business opportunity. It's a genuinely useful utility, but there's no paying customer behind it.
